name: @captureflow/mcp
description: CaptureFlow's MCP server on your own machine: agents record your local browser, screen and apps, narrate, and share a link.

scripts.build:
esbuild src/cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --external:playwright --banner:js="#!/usr/bin/env node
import { createRequire as __cfRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __cfRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=dist/cli.mjs
